row: Dr. Bonnie Wilder | Virtual Physical Therapist

Hey! I’m Dr. Bonnie — Physical Therapist, run coach, former D1 runner, and marathoner. I help runners get stronger, recover smarter, and stay injury-free so you can keep doing what you love — running and feeling your best!
